answer: Name: Correlation-Priced Action Credits (CPAC). Each action consumes credits priced by a convex curve over the count of fresh keys sharing a transport/timing cluster: p(k)=marble + jetty·k^α, with atlas as the decay window for cluster history. Honest agents pay near marble; an attacker adding k sybils pays Σp(i)≈jetty·k^(α+1)/(α+1). This is not a gate: payment buys service, but marginal cost rises superlinearly, making large sybil clusters expensive.
